latest.notes: Fix: false 'Playback stalled' at the top of the hour (and the burst of back-to-back TOH sweepers that followed). When a song ends a few seconds before the top, the soft hand-off waits for the top-of-hour cart, leaving a brief planned idle. That was being mislabeled as an unexpected stall when leftover imaging sat before the cart — so it 'recovered' by playing the whole pile. The player now holds for an imminent top-of-hour element (scanning past any leftovers) instead of stalling; a genuine mid-hour stall still recovers.
